The pilot signatures and fixed horizon support the static two-layer siphon family, not the memory ODE, which would require trajectory data.
Possible smooth alternative, but current evidence explicitly identifies a two-layer siphon base and does not indicate a barrier activation signature.
All rows share H=0.6 and the pilot signatures instead indicate base-field/sink-gradient response; no evidence supports spending on a long-horizon probe.
